title: gomphocarpus angustifolius
intro: Gomphocarpus angustifolius, commonly known as Balloon Cotton Bush, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Gomphocarpus angustifolius include wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction, attributed to its bioactive constituents. Research suggests the presence of alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids as the bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties.
